[Second-price (Vickrey) auction: truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy. There is no prior history to exploit and values are independent each round, so bidding my true value maximizes expected profit. With $0.1 increments I will bid my value $35.0 to win whenever the second-highest bid is below 35 and pay that price.]

[In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. With value $6, bidding $6 maximizes expected profit: I win when the highest other bid is below 6 and then pay the second-highest bid, yielding positive surplus when that bid is lower. There is no incentive to shade or inflate. I'll therefore bid $6.]
